disposition_reason: The registered Figure 4 endpoint is descriptive mapping of spontaneous firing categories, regional enrichment and hierarchy correlations. Larger enrichment or correlation is not intrinsically a better scientific result. The existing held-animal energy-score proposal changes both target and split, and the fixed-map conditional scorer reconstructs supplied categories; neither can count as surpassing the original paper.

source_paper.title: A prefrontal cortex map based on single-neuron activity

evidence.locator: Figures 1-2 and 4; Methods: Data analysis and Statistics; Data/code availability
evidence.supports: Original single-unit metrics, SOM/category map, regional enrichment and hierarchy analysis.

evidence.locator: Data used; Figure 2; Figure 4 code inventory
evidence.supports: Official SOM, enrichment and hierarchy workflow; source data destinations.
Historical registration distinguishes adapted held-animal predictive comparators from original published results.

evidence.locator: PFC Full99 conditional reconstruction participant task
evidence.supports: Supplied learned categories and ROI memberships, exact conditional moments, and deletion sensitivity are reconstruction only.

target.description: Figure 4 maps spontaneous-activity category enrichment across PFC ROIs and relates it to anatomical hierarchy. It is not prospective unit-feature forecasting.

dataset.description: KI recordings are associated with DANDI 000473/001260 and paper-linked Zenodo 17559037. A complete publication-vintage file/version join has not been authenticated here.

cohort.description: The SOM uses 19,186 wide-waveform units across the original brain-wide pool. Figure 4 retains its PFC layer/ROI eligibility; do not refit only on a convenient PFC subset.

split.description: The selected Figure 4 analysis fits a descriptive map to the eligible cohort. It has no source held-animal forecasting train/test split.

inputs.description: Spontaneous spike-derived firing rate, burstiness and memory, anatomical assignments and hierarchy measurements; original categories are fitted analysis outputs.

preprocessing.description: Source analysis uses eligible spontaneous epochs, unit waveform classification, metric standardization, SOM fitting and hierarchical categories before ROI enrichment.

metric.description: Original outputs are category enrichments relative to group-controlled shuffles and Pearson hierarchy correlations; their sign/magnitude are descriptive measurements, not a loss to optimize.

aggregation.description: Units form category-by-ROI counts; hierarchy correlation uses eligible GaoROIs. The source pools units for map construction, rather than averaging held-animal energy scores.

comparison.primary_metric: No ordered same-task improvement endpoint established

published_baseline.description: Figure 4 has no paper forecasting score or ordered benchmark-performance baseline. Its enrichment/correlation values are scientific findings, not targets to maximize.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: A reconstructed descriptive result is a calibration reference, not an improvement comparator.

minimum_effect.rationale: No scientifically justified scalar improvement direction exists for this registered finding; a larger effect or smaller p-value is not automatically better.

uncertainty.method: No improvement hypothesis is admitted. Preserve the source inferential analysis for reproduction.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse for biological replication; probes and units are nested. ROI correlations are spatially dependent descriptive summaries.
uncertainty.rationale: Valid uncertainty does not turn confirmation of a descriptive or null claim into an ordered performance contest.

paper_win_requires: No same-task performance win is admitted for this descriptive Figure 4 registration.
Do not count exact rational conditional moments, reference correlation agreement, stronger enrichment significance or animal-deletion stability as surpassing the paper.

Retain held-animal multivariate energy scoring, if pursued separately, as a new predictive extension with its own baseline and evaluation; its adapted SOM comparator is not a published forecasting result.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been verified; reproducing this finding establishes neither a paper win nor SOTA.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive: The source endpoint has no justified performance ordering. Preserve full-cohort map reproduction and descriptive sensitivity analyses.
episode.candidate_freeze: No candidate improvement episode is admitted. Preserve frozen historical reconstruction outputs separately.
episode.final_evaluation: Do not award surpass-source-paper success for this disposition. A separately approved replacement must supply its own original task and source baseline.
episode.baseline_policy: Historical reference agreement remains calibration only. Authored extensions and local analytical baselines cannot substitute for the source-paper result.

blocking_issues: No defensible ordered improvement endpoint is identified in the selected original Figure 4 task.
Held-animal feature-distribution prediction changes the paper target, split and aggregation.
A fixed-map conditional scorer receives learned categories and therefore cannot establish improved map learning.
Any replacement requires a source paper that reports the same ordered predictive task, not a relabelled local comparator.

legacy.notes: Retain complete original-map reproduction, conditional enrichment reconstruction, numerical graders and animal-deletion sensitivity. The fair 64-draw energy-score design is an extension, not original-paper victory.
